Join the team

Our Fall 2026 application process has three stages: a short written application, a coffee chat, and a technical interview.

Applications open September 1, 2026 and close October 3, 2026.

New members spend about 6-8 hours per week, and first-years are welcome to apply.

In Fall 2025 we received 180 applicants and accepted 30 new members.

Our process is highly competitive, but we read every application carefully.

Apply here: application form

The spring 2024 deadline was March 1, 2024.
